description: Save still images (png default, or jpg) of a video at given times to a folder on this machine. One time gives one image, several a .zip. Web videos are downloaded first (only the needed part when the times are close together). Files go to dir, else VID2CONTEXT_DOWNLOAD_DIR, else ~/Downloads/vid2context. Download only media you have the rights to: your own uploads, public-domain or Creative Commons works, or videos the site lets you download.

dir.description: Folder to save to: absolute, ~/..., or relative to the default folder

quality.description: Download size for web videos (smaller side), default 1080

url.description: Video URL, YouTube id or local file path

width.description: Width in pixels; default the source size

zip.description: Return a .zip even for one frame

name: grab_frames
title: Grab still frames from a video
